telegram.helpBody:
/status — application status
/projects — projects
/tasks [project-id] — tasks
/task task-id — status and actions
/run task-id — explicitly start or continue a workflow
/pause task-id — stop a workflow
/screenshot — capture the application window
/ask text — ask the selected assistant (or send a message)
/new {JSON} — create a task through typed createTask
/command {"method":"...","args":[...]} — explicit API command

Connection permissions and backend rules apply to every command. Run does not approve a document or plan. Decisions need current IDs and revision. Messages sent before bot activation are not executed.

api_saved_key_hint: Leave the key blank to keep the saved key when the endpoint is unchanged.
api_connection_apply_hint: Apply also reloads saved settings for the selected connection.
api_active_transport_hint: API mode pinned to this chat. Saved connection changes take effect after Apply.
image_viewer_hint: Drag to move. Use + or − to zoom, 0 to fit, 1 for 100%, and Escape to close.
grok_connector_profile_hint: Explicit Grok extension for Responses. Provider activity, native questions and native permissions are separate from tools that run on this computer. Capability discovery does not verify generation.
grok_inspect_save_first: Save this connection before checking its capabilities.
grok_media_limits: Video availability depends on the connector deployment. Audio is not supported by this profile. Tool names alone do not prove successful execution.
grok_provider_tools_hint: These are provider capabilities, not additional local filesystem or terminal permissions.
grok_usage_hint: The usage period is not a subscription expiry date. Missing usage is unknown, not zero.
provider_interaction_approval_hint: Choose one of the options supplied by the provider. This decision does not grant local tool permissions.
provider_interaction_question_hint: Answering a question does not approve commands or other actions.
provider_interaction_submitted: Response sent; waiting for provider state
provider_interaction_expired: This request is no longer active
provider_interaction_readonly: History only. This request cannot be answered in this session.
grok_catalog_unavailable: Model metadata is unavailable. Context window choices were not inferred.
grok_context_unverified: Saved value; not verified for this model
grok_context_model_hint: Choices come from the selected model in the saved connection’s model catalog. An empty list means no verified choices; Provider default remains available.
provider_interaction_plan_hint: These planning actions include selected single options only. Use Send answer to include your written response.
grok_images_invalid: The selected images do not belong to this chat or are no longer available. Refresh attachments.
grok_images_pending_send: This image delivery has not been acknowledged. Retry the same message or explicitly discard its image draft before changing attachments.
grok_images_context_hint: Unsent images belong to this session. Send or remove them before changing configuration or resuming. Images cannot be queued.
grok_images_cleanup_failed: The message was accepted, but local image cache cleanup failed.
grok_images_discard_hint: Delivery is not confirmed. Discarding removes the staged images and their retry identity, keeps your text, and does not undo a request the provider may already have accepted.
grok_auto_approve_permissions_hint: For new or reconfigured chats using this connection. Selects only a one-time permission offered by Grok. Questions and local file or command approvals still need your answer; read-only chats keep manual provider permissions.
updates.localOnly: Manage updates in the desktop app on this computer.
updates.manualInstall: Automatic installation is unavailable here. Download the package or open the release for manual installation.
updates.installNotice: Finish active work before updating. ZIAForge will close and may open the system installer.
claude_messages_hint: Claude Connector uses Anthropic Messages. Enter the server origin without /v1; the app adds the route. Other providers are not used as a fallback.
claude_connector_profile_hint: Caller tools work in this task's local workspace. Native tools run on the connector server and are disabled until you explicitly select them.
claude_discovery_mismatch: This connection did not return the Claude Connector contract.
claude_permission_hint: These permissions apply to native tools on the server. Selecting a tool does not approve its actions. Local task permissions remain separate.
claude_native_tools_hint: Choose only tools enabled by this connector. Discovery does not mean a tool has passed a real execution check.
claude_inspect_save_first: Save this connection, then inspect its capabilities to choose from the server's enabled tools and model options.
claude_max_tokens: Maximum output tokens per native request
claude_token_limit_hint: The token limit applies to one model request inside the agent cycle, not to total tokens or cost. The turn limit bounds the number of native steps.
claude_thinking_hint: Options come from the selected model's discovery. Missing capabilities remain unknown. The server validates model limits before execution.
claude_schema_invalid: Enter a JSON object for the schema, or clear the field.
claude_schema_hint: The connector validates the schema and final structured result. Draft-07 is supported; external references are not fetched.
claude_history_mode: History on a new native session
claude_history_hint: Context import starts a new session with historical text. It does not restore native state, attachments, signed thinking, interrupted tools or approvals.
claude_discovery_hint: Discovered, enabled and verified are separate states. Only declared capabilities are shown; this inspection does not run a model or certify every tool.
claude_limits_unknown: Limit data is unavailable. Remaining capacity is unknown, not zero usage.
claude_manual_renewal: Renewal date entered by the owner
claude_renewal_hint: A limit reset is not a subscription renewal. Billing dates are shown only when manually entered by the server owner.
claude_native_permission_hint: This decision applies only to the requested action on the Claude server. It does not grant access to local project tools.
artifact_unavailable: This file is unavailable in the current conversation.
